content.title: Arvada Police Honor Garden
content.summary: The Arvada Police Honor Garden, located in Memorial Park, is a memorial dedicated to police officers who have died in the line of duty, honoring four fallen officers: Dillon Vakoff, Gordon Beesley, W. Michael Northey, and Robert Beghtol. content.body:
The Arvada Police Honor Garden is a memorial on the west side of Memorial Park ([8001 W. 59th Ave.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nCKbU7TFfy2Bxp4q9)), across the street from City Hall and Arvada Police Headquarters. The garden serves as a permanent tribute to Arvada police officers who have died in the line of duty, and as a symbol of the community's appreciation for those who serve.

The project was constructed by the Arvada Police Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3) non-profit, in cooperation with the City of Arvada's Parks and Urban Design team.

### Honoring Our Fallen Officers

The Honor Garden memorializes four officers who gave their lives serving the Arvada community:

- Dillon Vakoff (2022)
- Gordon Beesley (2021)
- W. Michael Northey (1979)
- Robert Beghtol (1961)

### Timeline

Construction on the Honor Garden began on March 6, 2026. The Honor Garden was [dedicated on May 28, 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yvWCTpMp8I), at the Arvada Police Department's annual fallen officer memorial ceremony.

### Learn More

For more information about the Arvada Police Honor Garden and other Foundation initiatives, visit the [Arvada Police Foundation website](https://www.arvadapolicefoundation.org/honorgarden).
